package usecase

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/domain"
)

type EventSink interface {
	Publish(ctx context.Context, ev domain.Event) error
}

type InterestingActivityPublisher interface {
	PublishInterestingActivity(ctx context.Context, activity domain.InterestingActivity) error
}

// ErrorLogger is the use-case logging port. Concrete logging stays in
// infrastructure and is supplied by the composition root.
type ErrorLogger interface {
	Error(message string, err error, eventID string)
}

type EventService struct {
	sink        EventSink
	logger      ErrorLogger
	interesting InterestingActivityPublisher
}

func NewEventService(sink EventSink, logger ErrorLogger, publishers ...InterestingActivityPublisher) *EventService {
	service := &EventService{sink: sink, logger: logger}
	if len(publishers) > 0 {
		service.interesting = publishers[0]
	}
	return service
}

type RequestMeta struct {
	UserID   uuid.UUID
	Role     string
	Language string
}

type SessionStartRequest struct {
	CourseID   uuid.UUID
	LessonID   uuid.UUID
	TaskID     uuid.UUID
	Platform   string
	EditorMode string
	ClientTS   *time.Time
	Payload    map[string]any
}

type IncomingEvent struct {
	EventID    uuid.UUID      `json:"event_id,omitempty"`
	SessionID  uuid.UUID      `json:"session_id"`
	EventType  string         `json:"event_type"`
	EditorMode *string        `json:"editor_mode,omitempty"`
	Platform   *string        `json:"platform,omitempty"`
	ClientTS   *time.Time     `json:"client_ts,omitempty"`
	Payload    map[string]any `json:"payload"`
	CourseID   *uuid.UUID     `json:"course_id,omitempty"`
	LessonID   *uuid.UUID     `json:"lesson_id,omitempty"`
	TaskID     *uuid.UUID     `json:"task_id,omitempty"`
}

type EventsBatchRequest struct {
	CourseID   uuid.UUID
	LessonID   uuid.UUID
	TaskID     uuid.UUID
	Platform   string
	EditorMode string
	Events     []IncomingEvent
}

type SessionStartResponse struct {
	SessionID uuid.UUID
	StartedAt time.Time
}

var (
	ErrInvalidInput = errors.New("invalid input")
)

func (s *EventService) StartSession(ctx context.Context, meta RequestMeta, req SessionStartRequest) (*SessionStartResponse, error) {
	if err := validateMeta(meta); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := validateSessionStart(req); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	sessionID := uuid.New()
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	payload, err := marshalPayload(req.Payload)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	ev := domain.Event{
		EventTS:    now,
		UserID:     meta.UserID,
		Role:       meta.Role,
		SessionID:  sessionID,
		CourseID:   req.CourseID,
		LessonID:   req.LessonID,
		TaskID:     req.TaskID,
		Platform:   req.Platform,
		EditorMode: req.EditorMode,
		ClientTS:   req.ClientTS,
		EventType:  domain.EventTypeSessionStart,
		Payload:    payload,
	}

	if err := s.sink.Publish(ctx, ev); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return &SessionStartResponse{
		SessionID: sessionID,
		StartedAt: now,
	}, nil
}

func (s *EventService) PublishBatch(ctx context.Context, meta RequestMeta, batch EventsBatchRequest) (int, error) {
	if err := validateMeta(meta); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	if err := validateBatch(batch); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}

	accepted := 0
	for _, inc := range batch.Events {
		ev, err := s.buildEvent(meta, batch, inc)
		if err != nil {
			return accepted, err
		}
		activity, activityErr := interestingActivityFromEvent(ev)
		if activityErr != nil {
			return accepted, activityErr
		}
		if err := s.sink.Publish(ctx, ev); err != nil {
			return accepted, err
		}
		accepted++
		if s.interesting != nil && activity != nil {
			if publishErr := s.interesting.PublishInterestingActivity(ctx, *activity); publishErr != nil {
				s.logger.Error("failed to publish interesting learning activity", publishErr, activity.EventID.String())
			}
		}
	}

	return accepted, nil
}

func (s *EventService) buildEvent(meta RequestMeta, batch EventsBatchRequest, inc IncomingEvent) (domain.Event, error) {
	if inc.SessionID == uuid.Nil {
		return domain.Event{}, fmt.Errorf("session_id is required: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if !isAllowedEventType(inc.EventType) {
		return domain.Event{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported event_type: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if isInterestingEventType(inc.EventType) && inc.EventID == uuid.Nil {
		return domain.Event{}, fmt.Errorf("event_id is required for intervention-relevant activity: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	eventCourseID := pickUUID(inc.CourseID, batch.CourseID)
	eventLessonID := pickUUID(inc.LessonID, batch.LessonID)
	eventTaskID := pickUUID(inc.TaskID, batch.TaskID)

	if eventCourseID == uuid.Nil || eventLessonID == uuid.Nil || eventTaskID == uuid.Nil {
		return domain.Event{}, fmt.Errorf("course_id, lesson_id and task_id are required: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}

	platform := batch.Platform
	if inc.Platform != nil {
		platform = *inc.Platform
	}
	editorMode := batch.EditorMode
	if inc.EditorMode != nil {
		editorMode = *inc.EditorMode
	}

	payload, err := marshalPayload(inc.Payload)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Event{}, err
	}

	return domain.Event{
		EventTS:       time.Now().UTC(),
		SourceEventID: inc.EventID,
		UserID:        meta.UserID,
		Role:          meta.Role,
		SessionID:     inc.SessionID,
		CourseID:      eventCourseID,
		LessonID:      eventLessonID,
		TaskID:        eventTaskID,
		Platform:      platform,
		EditorMode:    editorMode,
		ClientTS:      inc.ClientTS,
		EventType:     inc.EventType,
		Payload:       payload,
	}, nil
}

func isInterestingEventType(eventType string) bool {
	switch eventType {
	case domain.EventTypeStudentStuck, domain.EventTypeStudentIdle, domain.EventTypeCompilerError,
		domain.EventTypeTestFailed, domain.EventTypeTestPassed:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func interestingActivityFromEvent(event domain.Event) (*domain.InterestingActivity, error) {
	if !isInterestingEventType(event.EventType) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	var payload struct {
		ConsecutiveFailures int    `json:"consecutive_failures"`
		SameErrorCount      int    `json:"same_error_count"`
		ActiveSeconds       int    `json:"active_seconds"`
		IdleSeconds         int    `json:"idle_seconds"`
		Progressing         bool   `json:"progressing"`
		ErrorFingerprint    string `json:"error_fingerprint"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(event.Payload, &payload); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("invalid activity payload: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if payload.ConsecutiveFailures < 0 || payload.ConsecutiveFailures > 1000 || payload.SameErrorCount < 0 || payload.SameErrorCount > 1000 ||
		payload.ActiveSeconds < 0 || payload.ActiveSeconds > 86400 || payload.IdleSeconds < 0 || payload.IdleSeconds > 86400 || len(payload.ErrorFingerprint) > 128 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("activity aggregate is out of bounds: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	signalType := ""
	switch event.EventType {
	case domain.EventTypeStudentStuck:
		signalType = "student_stuck"
	case domain.EventTypeStudentIdle:
		if payload.IdleSeconds < 480 {
			return nil, nil
		}
		signalType = "student_idle"
	case domain.EventTypeCompilerError, domain.EventTypeTestFailed:
		if payload.SameErrorCount < 3 || payload.ActiveSeconds < 480 {
			return nil, nil
		}
		signalType = "repeated_failure"
	case domain.EventTypeTestPassed:
		signalType, payload.Progressing = "progressing", true
	}
	return &domain.InterestingActivity{
		EventID: event.SourceEventID, StudentID: event.UserID, AnalyticsSessionID: event.SessionID,
		CourseID: event.CourseID, LessonID: event.LessonID, TaskID: event.TaskID, SignalType: signalType,
		ConsecutiveFailures: payload.ConsecutiveFailures, SameErrorCount: payload.SameErrorCount,
		ActiveSeconds: payload.ActiveSeconds, IdleSeconds: payload.IdleSeconds, Progressing: payload.Progressing,
		ErrorFingerprint: payload.ErrorFingerprint, OccurredAt: event.EventTS,
	}, nil
}

func validateMeta(meta RequestMeta) error {
	if meta.UserID == uuid.Nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("user_id is required: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if meta.Role == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("role is required: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	return nil
}

func validateSessionStart(req SessionStartRequest) error {
	if req.CourseID == uuid.Nil || req.LessonID == uuid.Nil || req.TaskID == uuid.Nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("course_id, lesson_id and task_id are required: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if req.Platform == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("platform is required: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if req.EditorMode == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("editor_mode is required: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	return nil
}

func validateBatch(batch EventsBatchRequest) error {
	if batch.CourseID == uuid.Nil || batch.LessonID == uuid.Nil || batch.TaskID == uuid.Nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("course_id, lesson_id and task_id are required: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if batch.Platform == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("platform is required: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if batch.EditorMode == "" {
		return fmt.Errorf("editor_mode is required: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	if len(batch.Events) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("events are required: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	return nil
}

func marshalPayload(payload map[string]any) ([]byte, error) {
	if payload == nil {
		payload = map[string]any{}
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("payload must be a valid json object: %w", ErrInvalidInput)
	}
	return data, nil
}

func isAllowedEventType(eventType string) bool {
	if eventType == "" {
		return false
	}
	if _, ok := domain.AllowedEventTypes[eventType]; ok {
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func pickUUID(val *uuid.UUID, fallback uuid.UUID) uuid.UUID {
	if val != nil {
		return *val
	}
	return fallback
}
